title: How AI Agents Actually Work
caption: Most people think an AI agent is a chatbot with extra steps. It is a loop: reason, call a tool, observe, remember, repeat. Here is the whole trick in under a minute.

scenes.narration: Most people think an AI agent is just a chatbot with extra steps. It isn't.
scenes.title: Not a chatbot with extra steps.

scenes.narration: A chatbot answers once. An agent runs a loop: it thinks, it acts, it observes the result, and it thinks again.
scenes.title: Chatbots answer once. Agents run a loop.

scenes.narration: First, it reasons. The model breaks your goal into steps and picks the next one. Find the paper. Read the abstract. Summarize it.
scenes.title: Step one: reason

data.goal: Summarize the latest paper on agent memory

scenes.narration: Then it acts by calling a tool. It writes a structured request, like search with a query, and a real program runs it and sends the result back.
scenes.title: Step two: call a tool

response.top: Memory in LLM agents: a survey

scenes.narration: Every result goes into memory. A scratchpad for this task, and sometimes a vector store it can search again later.
scenes.title: Step three: remember

scenes.narration: Now loop it. Reason, call, observe, remember, until the goal is done. That loop is the whole trick.
scenes.title: The loop is the whole trick.

scenes.narration: So an agent is not a smarter chatbot. It's a model with hands and a memory. Follow for AI explained in under a minute.
scenes.title: A model with hands and a memory.
scenes.cta: Follow for AI explained in a minute
